title: Responsible agent field in run status.json
description: Add a responsible_agent field to every run's status.json. When a run is created or a stage transition occurs, the system records which agent identity is driving that stage. The field must contain the agent_id. Update the status.json schema to include this field as required. Update the run creation and stage transition logic to populate it.
stop_condition: Every run's status.json contains a responsible_agent field identifying the agent driving the current stage.
